debugExport.title: Export Debug Information
debugExport.description: VectorXR will package troubleshooting details into a ZIP file you can share during testing.

items.logs: Retained VectorXR logs and the latest Frame Generation trace (Debug logging)
items.turboSafety: Turbo safety blocks and fault history

debugExport.limits: Raw files are limited to 8 MiB each and 64 MiB total, and the ZIP is compressed. Larger logs include their start and their latest output; omitted or limited files are listed in the ZIP. Cleared history and metrics that were not recorded are unavailable.
debugExport.privacy: The package may include local file paths and game executable names. It does not include system environment variables or unrelated files.
